items.title: Keep dog on leash (max. 2 m) and muzzled outside your fenced property
items.quote: Nach dem Gesetz über das Halten von Hunden ordne ich deshalb an, dass Sie Ihren Hund außerhalb Ihres eingefriedeten Grundstücks ab sofort an einer höchstens zwei Meter langen Leine führen und ihm einen Maulkorb anlegen.
items.computation: The order states the leash/muzzle requirement applies 'ab sofort' (immediately). As an administrative act (Verwaltungsakt) it becomes legally effective upon Bekanntgabe (notification). The letter is dated/posted 02.07.2025 (Wed); per the letter's own clause a letter sent by post counts as notified on the 4th day after posting: 02.07.2025 + 4 days = 06.07.2025 (Sunday). This is a general (non-tax) authority (Ordnungsamt), so the delivery day does not move to the next working day even though it falls on a Sunday. Hence the obligation takes legal effect from 06.07.2025, i.e. immediately upon notification.

items.title: File Widerspruch against the leash/muzzle order
items.quote: Gegen diese Anordnung ist innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch beim Amt Musterflens-Land, Amtsweg 1, 24983 Beispielhusby, gegeben – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Posting/letter date: 02.07.2025 (Wednesday). Per the letter's own rule, a postally sent letter counts as notified (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 02.07.2025 + 4 calendar days = 06.07.2025 (Sunday). Because this is a general authority (Ordnungsamt), not a tax office, the delivery/notification day is NOT shifted to the next working day even though it falls on a Sunday (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG / Landesrecht; the 4-day rule applies but no Saturday/Sunday/holiday adjustment of the delivery day itself for non-tax authorities). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO) starts the day after notification (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 07.07.2025, and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the day of notification: 06.08.2025. This falls on a Wednesday, a normal working day in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift is needed (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG would move it only if it fell on a weekend/holiday).

warnings: The printed Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung text is partly obscured/cut off in the photographed letter (the sentence structure around 'der Widerspruch ... gegeben' looks reconstructed from a damaged scan); verify the exact wording and address on the original document before relying on it.
No monetary amount, fine or fee is demanded in this letter — it is a behavioral order (leash/muzzle requirement), not a payment demand.
